Strategy: Reward bins whose post-placement residual is a multiple of five, encouraging round leftover sizes that may tile better with future items, on top of Best Fit tightness. It may help if item sizes are often multiples of five, but may fail if residuals land on multiples of five only by chance.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (30 if (r - item) % 5 == 0 else 0) for r in bins]
```
